messages:
Emma (AE): Starting a short sync for Skyline Bank POC — key asks: delegated domain verification, minimal SCIM provisioning, SAML mappings, per-subsidiary RBAC, and single contract billing with per-namespace metering. Please reply with short bullets. :wave:
Marta (Skyline IT): Hi all  corporate wants one invoice but each legal unit must retain admin control over their domain and admins. Also SCIM must only create accounts for a small set of groups. No blanket provisioning.
Noah (SE): TL;DR: delegated DNS TXT per-namespace (preferred) or admin-email verification; SCIM whitelist + server-side filter; SAML SP metadata and recommended attributes. Example TXT: `_rdw-verify=pub_1a2b3c`. Verify with `dig TXT _rdw-verify.sub.skyline.com`.
Priya (Security): Confirm we never request DNS admin credentials. We log SAML auth events but do not persist raw assertions by default. I'll attach a 1-page FAQ on KMS, TLS ciphers, and audit log residency.
Marta (Skyline IT): Good. For SCIM: groups allowed to provision: service-ops, platform-admins, compliance. Can you enforce server-side whitelist in addition to IdP filtering?
Noah (SE): Yes  we'll set a provisioning whitelist on our side and recommend configuring the IdP to only send those groups. For the POC we'll enable whitelist + link-only mode by default.
Emma (AE): Link-only for regulated subsidiaries; create-on-provision for sandbox. Note: procurement asks whether reserved capacity discounts can be applied per-subsidiary under a single reserved contract.
finance-bot: Discounts apply at contract level. We can allocate credits or show per-namespace discounts in billing reports. Finance needs forecast: steady tokens/day, avg sequence length, and % streaming.
Marta (Skyline IT): We'll provide estimates. Also: can domain verification be delegated to a subsidiary admin without giving billing access?
Noah (SE): Yes  admin roles are namespace-scoped; domain verification tokens are issued per-namespace. Billing owner is separate and can remain corporate. We'll document exact permission scopes.
Priya (Security): Retention question: hosted supports default short retention; long-term retention is an add-on. Dedicated/Private support configurable retention per-namespace. Also can disable storing `last_login` if required.
Noah (SE): SAML SP example values: entityID `https://accounts.redwood.ai/sp/skyline`, ACS `https://accounts.redwood.ai/saml/acs/skyline`. Recommended attributes: NameID (email), givenName, familyName, groups. We accept signed assertions and MFA-enforced IdPs.
Marta (Skyline IT): Can you provide a tiny SCIM curl for link-only so our IdP team can test?
Noah (SE): Sure — sample link-only create (will 404 if user unknown):
```bash
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <PROV_TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users \
  -d '{"userName":"sam.ops@sub.skyline.com","emails":[{"value":"sam.ops@sub.skyline.com"}],"externalId":"ext-42"}'
```
Priya (Security): Action items: I'll publish the security FAQ (KMS/customer-managed KMS options, HSM for Private, TLS details, audit log residency, retention). Noah: SAML metadata + SCIM whitelist template + DNS TXT rotation playbook. Emma: assemble pricing template and POC checklist. Ops-bot: schedule kickoff.
ops-bot: POC kickoff scheduled Mon 09:00 UTC. :calendar:
Emma (AE): Thanks team — I'll send the prep pack to Marta once attachments land. Any remaining blockers?
Marta (Skyline IT): One compliance blocker remains: they want a signed attestation that domain verification did not require handing over any DNS privs. Is that something you can provide?
Priya (Security): We can provide a short signed attestation PDF stating our DNS verification process (owner adds TXT, Redwood validates via public DNS; no credentials required). I'll include it in the FAQ pack.
Emma (AE): Perfect. Closing this thread, will follow up with the packet. :thumbsup:
